address: Tampines Round Market & Food Centre, #01-45, 137 Tampines Street 11, 521137, Singapore
bio: The signature kolo mee set menu is a tour de force starring everything the stall has to offer – braised spareribs, wontons, char siew and curly, bouncy kolo noodles dressed in lard and shallot oil. Ipoh hor fun is also available....
